description: Run when you need to know which tokens a wallet holds and how much. Ranked by USD value, with unverified (often spam airdrop) tokens flagged so you don't report fake holdings. Lists a wallet's tokens (SPL Token and Token-2022) with exact amounts, whether each is verified, and its USD value where there's a price. Inputs: wallet: The wallet address to read the tokens of. how_many (optional): How many tokens, highest USD value first, to return. Default 25. include_empty (optional): Whether to include empty token accounts. Default false. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/tokens.
name: tokens
